new_class_ruling.definition: A mis-stated statement of what a loan built or where: the sections, route, components or works a card says the money paid for, measured against the completion report's own component or section description.
new_class_ruling.why_not_an_existing_class: partial_list is defined for safeguard-policy lists and its test is whether the appraisal document's safeguards table marks a policy triggered, which is meaningless for a railway route. The other nine classes turn on which document or which column a figure came from, not on what the loan built. The test for a scope claim is its own: does the completion report's description of the components or sections match what the card says the money financed.
